name: a-comment-is-not-a-definition-of-the-test-only-flag
find: line for line in manifest.split("\n") if not line.strip().startswith("#")
breaks: the guard counts mentions rather than definitions again, so any comment naming the test-only flag fails a check about something the comment did not do, and the message blames the app target for a second definition nobody wrote (#853, L11, L103)
